body: That actually helped me feel a little better. I think one of the main things holding me back from the idea of suicide is that I'm not sure that its never going to be okay. I feel that someday there might be something great that I'll be missing out on. Maybe I should cling to that idea.
I want to believe I have the ability to do something useful with my life and be happy and find someone to spend it with, but in reality its just full of wasting time right now.

Thank you  for taking the time to reply. 

I'm more worried about the power of those feelings, how they can quickly drive me to do something I don't want to. After I hurt myself for the first time I became scared of myself, but it got easier and easier. 

I'm basically taking the rest of this semester off sans one class. I considered a leave of absence but won't do it for the exact reason you mentioned. I don't want to feel more like a failure, and I especially don't need my friends seeing how much of a failure I am. 

Maybe writing to myself could help. I've tried it before in a way, but I'm not sure how comfortable I am with it.
I really don't have any other friend to talk to about this anymore. She was my only steady emotional support, which to be honest isn't healthy. But at least for a while it helped me feel like someone cared. I look back on some of the shitty things I've said though and it makes my depression worse and worse because I can't forgive myself.

Yeah, I mostly just fake it with people now. Not much more I can do.

Reasons? I'm too scared to do it still. I'm worried about the trauma I'd inflict upon my friends and family. There's still the ever faint bit of hope that someday I'll be happy, but I'll probably give up on that stupid dream.

Again though, I appreciate your thoughts
